description: This PHP class defines a deprecated Drupal migration source plugin for exporting content entities using the Entity API. It includes methods for initializing data, loading entities, converting entities to arrays, querying entities, and handling entity IDs and fields. The class is designed to be extended or replaced in newer Drupal versions.

classes.name: ContentEntity
classes.description: A deprecated Drupal migration source plugin class for exporting content entities, supporting entity data retrieval, translation inclusion, and field handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the plugin, setting up entity type, bundle, and configuration, with deprecation warning.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the plural label of the entity type.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Initializes data source iterator by executing entity query.

methods.name: yieldEntities
methods.description: Loads and yields entities and their translations based on IDs.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts an entity to an array with flattened IDs.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns an entity query based on configuration.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns count of entities, handling translation inclusion.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Retrieves list of entity fields, handling non-fieldable entities.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns array of entity IDs, revision ID, and language code if applicable.
